issues.title: vectorElemMinSize returns 1 (not 0) for a zero-dimension fixed-size inner vector
issues.verdictReason: Traced vectorElemMinSize(vector<float,0>): vectorFixedElemSize returns 0 (TypeCustom), isVectorVariableLengthType returns false for float, the vec.Dimensions>0 branch is skipped since Dimensions==0, so size stays 0 and the size<1 floor forces a return of 1 even though such a value truly encodes to 0 bytes (confirmed by the explicit 0-dimension zero-byte handling at marshal.go:1065-1076); an outer vector<vector<T,0>,N> with an empty payload is then wrongly rejected as not fitting.

issues.title: vectorElemMinSize recursion nil-derefs on a nested VectorType with nil SubType
issues.verdictReason: If elemType is itself a VectorType whose own SubType field is nil (only reachable via a hand-built VectorType, since asVectorType/getCassandraLongType never produce a nil SubType), vectorFixedElemSize(nil) calls nil.Type() and panics. However this exact hazard (nil SubType inside a nested VectorType) already exists on main via isVectorVariableLengthType's own VectorType recursion (marshal.go:1190-1194, unchanged by this PR) and via marshalVector's direct call to isVectorVariableLengthType(info.SubType) -- so this class of panic predates the PR.
issues.scopeReason: The same nil-SubType-in-nested-vector panic is already reachable on main through isVectorVariableLengthType, which this PR does not touch; the PR adds another path to the same pre-existing hazard rather than creating it.

issues.title: NULL vector value with negative Dimensions metadata now errors instead of decoding to zero
issues.verdictReason: The new `info.Dimensions < 0` check at marshal.go:992-994 runs unconditionally, before the `data != nil` check; on main, a NULL value (data == nil) with Dimensions < 0 fell through to the reflect.Slice/Array `data == nil` branch and decoded to nil/zero with no error. The PR description's "Behaviour change" section only calls out short/zero-length non-NULL payloads, not this NULL-with-negative-Dimensions case.
issues.scopeReason: The negative-dimensions check and its ordering relative to the nil-data check are new code added by this PR.
